mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, real_name, id_card, id_card_front, id_card_back, bank_name, bank_card, phone, email, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{idCard}, #{idCardFront}, #{idCardBack}, #{bankName}, #{bankCard}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile SET real_name = #{realName}, id_card = #{idCard}, id_card_front = #{idCardFront}, id_card_back = #{idCardBack}, bank_name = #{bankName}, bank_card = #{bankCard}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, status = #{status}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_profile WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.create_time AS createTime, p.id, p.real_name AS realName, p.id_card AS idCard, p.id_card_front AS idCardFront, p.id_card_back AS idCardBack, p.bank_name AS bankName, p.bank_card AS bankCard, p.phone, p.email, p.status, p.audit_time AS auditTime FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.role = 0 ORDER BY u.id ASC
